findings.title: Jobs treats a capped row window as platform-wide totals

reproduction.scenario: 350 recent jobs; list limit300; separate recent-date query limit3000, subject to API max_rows1000
reproduction.expected: Global totals count all qualifying rows; records outside a view remain reachable through bounded server paging/search.
reproduction.actual: Roles on the platform300/every row in jobs while Posted this week350. Company/location/type aggregates and local search use only newest300; time-series read has a second row cap.

findings.environment: Actual frozen admin modules and installed SDK with synthetic transport; browser cases use actual returned page props/client components with explicit Next/Shell adapters.
findings.proposedBoundedFix: Exact HEAD counts for all/7day/previous7day/30day; bounded server pagination with deterministic order and search. Label distribution/unique-company/remote metrics as the displayed/recent window unless supplied by a bounded aggregate contract. Never fetch all rows unbounded.
proposedRegressions: More than300 and more thanAPImax rows; exact global counts independent of page; next page/search reaches older row; query errors remain errors; scoped chart labels.
limits: No hosted production/provider mutation or total-latency claim.

findings.title: Calls live and weekly summaries omit sessions outside newest400

reproduction.scenario: 500 recent sessions with one still-active session outside newest400
reproduction.expected: Live/weekly totals include every matching call; row-window statistics have explicit scope.
reproduction.actual: Sessions on file500, This week400, Live right now0,400 minutes on file.

findings.environment: Actual frozen admin modules and installed SDK with synthetic transport; browser cases use actual returned page props/client components with explicit Next/Shell adapters.
findings.proposedBoundedFix: Separate exact filtered HEAD counts for live/current/previous periods; preserve all-time count. Label duration/answer-rate/status/type series as bounded row-window metrics until a server aggregate is available; bounded history paging.
proposedRegressions: Active call older than row window; >400 calls in week; distinct global and sample labels; provider errors; bounded history access.
limits: No hosted production/provider mutation or total-latency claim.

findings.title: Expired story metric filters creation time instead of expiry window

reproduction.scenario: 250 stories created30hours ago and expired6hours ago (normal24hour lifetime)
reproduction.expected: A clearly labeled expired-last24hours metric counts250, or an explicitly different defined window.
reproduction.actual: Expired in24hours0 because query applies expires_at<now AND created_at>now-24h.

findings.environment: Actual frozen admin modules and installed SDK with synthetic transport; browser cases use actual returned page props/client components with explicit Next/Shell adapters.
findings.proposedBoundedFix: Define label as Expired in last24hours and use expires_at>=now-24h AND expires_at<now with exact HEAD count. If product wants future expiry, label Expiring in next24hours and query that window instead.
proposedRegressions: Normal24hour lifetime; exact lower/upper expiry boundaries; unrelated creation dates; null expiry excluded.
limits: No hosted production/provider mutation or total-latency claim.

reproduction.expected: Pending total1001 and bounded paged access to all submissions.

findings.environment: Actual frozen admin modules and installed SDK with synthetic transport; browser cases use actual returned page props/client components with explicit Next/Shell adapters.
findings.proposedBoundedFix: Exact status-filtered HEAD pending count plus deterministic bounded server pages; batch related reads only for page IDs. Label tier mix as page/sample and median as latest60decisions unless aggregated. Do not solve by increasing/removing the provider cap.

findings.title: Verification safety reads fan out once per pending applicant

reproduction.expected: Request work remains bounded by a small page and a controlled concurrency or aggregate contract.
reproduction.actual: Actual SDK emits25 separate member_strikes HEAD requests in an eager Promise.all; up to1000 applicant reads are possible under current cap.

findings.environment: Actual frozen admin modules and installed SDK with synthetic transport; browser cases use actual returned page props/client components with explicit Next/Shell adapters.
findings.proposedBoundedFix: Page first; bound concurrency and preserve exact safety counts. A future authorized batched aggregate RPC can reduce round trips, but no unbounded all-strikes fetch and no migration activation in this audit.
proposedRegressions: Bound emitted request count/concurrency to page; exact large strike count; denied/error count stops action; no missing-as-zero fallback.
limits: 25 emitted calls reproduced. No real network latency/OOM or saturation was measured; this is demonstrated request amplification.
